scope: Reviewed reusable-answer suggestions now distinguish exact normalization, bounded token-edit fuzzy matches, and one explicitly curated semantic synonym family. Export rechecks the selected match against the current locked profile snapshot and persists match provenance in the immutable document manifest.

acceptance.exact_normalization: PASS; case and punctuation variants produce EXACT_NORMALIZATION with score 1.0.
acceptance.fuzzy_matching: PASS for bounded question edits; token edit-distance score and required token overlap are recomputed server-side.
acceptance.semantic_similarity: PARTIAL; CURATED_SEMANTIC recognizes only an explicit programming-language synonym set at 0.95. This is deterministic and labeled as local curated rules; general semantic understanding is not claimed.
acceptance.suggestion_and_review_gate: PASS; the UI shows method, match score, saved question, saved-answer confidence and source. A suggestion does not populate the answer until selected; selection requires deliberate per-application review before export. Prompt or answer edits clear selection/review.
acceptance.sensitive_and_legal_questions: PASS; sensitive/legal prompts remain excluded from reusable suggestions and export, including the work-authorization example. No profile policy or inference behavior was added.
acceptance.stale_approval_and_source: PASS; server recomputes a selected match from the current profile version under the existing export lock. Substantive source edits revoke approval; reusing the stale selected answer is rejected.
acceptance.provenance_history_and_download: PASS; immutable export metadata records employer question, saved question/id, match method/score, source and saved-answer confidence. The synthetic browser flow verified history reload and identical downloaded bytes/hash; integration verified profile isolation and preserved old export bytes after an answer-source edit.

checks.target: local unit matcher and synthetic SQLite/API export workflow
isolated loopback Chromium answer suggestion, review reset, history reload and download
apps/web TypeScript and Vite production build

limitations.overall_requirement: PARTIAL; only a bounded fuzzy edit-distance strategy and one curated semantic synonym group are implemented. Broad semantic matching and configurable confidence thresholds remain separate/incomplete acceptance.

red_first_observation.details: Expected 201; exact-only backend guard returned 422 with reusable answer question mismatch. This was the intended pre-fix red oracle.
